title: Motorcycle - Biker reunion by Vrymaa
author: Vrymaa
sourceDescription: Bikers having their motorcycles blessed, idle motors passing in front of me with power exhaust sounds. Nice Harley-Davidson ambience and other custom bobber motorcycles. I removed the kids screaming and the extatic crowd cheering in background. * No background noise. * No reverb nor echo. * Clean sound, close range. Recorded with Iphone 8 or Thomann micro t.bone SC 420.
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain -1.70 dB (peak -2.30 dBFS); 30 ms fades
